# `inspectors_general_report_metadata`

**Selected inspector-general report metadata**

One original report-metadata observation at an immutable archive commit, retaining both complete parsed metadata and exact source JSON bytes.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected original report JSON at an immutable archive commit. Path year, record year and publication text remain separate; declared asset links do not establish acquired bodies or broader archive coverage. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `inspectors_general_report_metadata.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
